question: In which year was the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award renamed as Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna award, which is the highest sporting honour in the nation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award was renamed as Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna award in **2021**.
 
• This renaming was done by the Government of India to honor the legendary Indian hockey player, Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• Major Dhyan Chand is widely regarded as one of the greatest field hockey players in history, known for his extraordinary goal-scoring feats.
 
• The decision to rename the award was made to celebrate the legacy and contribution of Major Dhyan Chand to Indian sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**

 
 
• Instituted in 1991-92, it is the highest sporting honor of the Republic of India.
 
• The award is given annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• It is awarded for the most outstanding performance by a sportsperson over a period of four years.
 
• The award comprises a medallion, a certificate, and a cash prize.
 
 
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand**
 
 
• Dhyan Chand (1905-1979) was an Indian field hockey player, often referred to as "The Wizard" for his superb ball control.
 
• He played a pivotal role in India's three consecutive Olympic gold medals in field hockey in 1928, 1932, and 1936.
 
• His birthday, 29th August, is celebrated as National Sports Day in India.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan, India's third-highest civilian honor, in 1956.
 
 
 
• **Other Major Sports Awards in India**
 
 
• **Arjuna Award**: Given for outstanding performance in sports and games.
 
• **Dronacharya Award**: Awarded to coaches for producing medal winners at prestigious international sports events.
 
• **Dhyanchand Award**: Given for lifetime achievement in sports and games.
 
• **Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar**: Given to corporate entities and individuals for playing a significant role in the area of sports promotion and development.
